Class AutoAssignmentsService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.AutoAssignmentsService
@Service public class AutoAssignmentsService extends Object
Automatically Assign No-Conflict Slots (issue #481): fills every place where there is one clear, rational choice. A lecture that still needs assignments gets its highest-ranked remaining candidate when that candidate is enthusiastic about the course and no other lecture that still needs assignments has ranked them at all. Passes are repeated until one makes no assignment.

For a TA recruitment (issue #488) only PhD students in Computer Science are ever assigned automatically. An MS student, or a PhD student in another major, is still a candidate, so a lecture whose top remaining candidate is one gets nothing and is listed with the reason: passing over them to the next PhD would override the instructor's ranking, which is a person's call. A ULA recruitment has no class levels and the rule does not apply.

The planning is pure (plan(AssignmentsService.Assignments, Set)) and works on the page's own data, so the controller tests and this service's tests need no database. Within a pass, two assignments can never share a candidate (a shared candidate is ranked by two needing lectures, so blocked for both) or a lecture, and making one only removes blockers, never adds one; so the result does not depend on the order lectures are visited, and repeating until nothing changes is safe.

  • Method Details

    • plan

      public static AutoAssignmentsService.Plan plan(AssignmentsService.Assignments page, Set<Long> ineligible)
      plan(Assignments, Set, Map) with nobody restricted to manual assignment.

    • plan

      public static AutoAssignmentsService.Plan plan(AssignmentsService.Assignments page, Set<Long> ineligible, Map<Long,String> manualOnly)
      Plans a run over the page as it stands, without changing anything. ineligible are the applications never to assign (those marked Not Hired): they are left out of every ranking list, as if already placed, so they neither receive a place nor hold one up. manualOnly are the applications that may only be assigned by hand (issue #488), each with the reason code (NOT_PHD or NOT_CS_MAJOR): they stay in every ranking list, so a lecture whose top remaining candidate is one of them gets nothing, with that reason.

    • run

      @Transactional public AutoAssignmentsService.Outcome run(Recruitment recruitment)
      Plans and makes the run's assignments, all in one transaction: if any application cannot be saved (its own version moved, issue #302), none of them is changed. The answer carries the assignments as they stand afterwards.

    • undo

      @Transactional public AutoAssignmentsService.Undone undo(Recruitment recruitment, List<AutoAssignmentsService.Made> made)
      Undoes a run: clears exactly the given assignments, and only where the application is still pencilled into the lecture the run put it in, so a placement changed by hand since is kept. All in one transaction.
